title: plugin-manifest — IS marketplace-tier contract (composition)
description: The published, canonical plugin-manifest authoring contract (the `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` shape). PURE COMPOSITION — zero authored fields of its own. It is the allOf of three layers: (1) the upstream base (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference, authored by THEM); (2) the three universal folds (deprecationRegistry, securityChecks, disclosureMarkers) by $ref to the shared foundation; (3) the IS overlay (authored by US). This is authoring contract #2 — the FIRST contract that is codegen-generated (DR-044 D8: single-source codegen is a hard precondition of contract #2, not #1). The Zod validator AND this inline $comment effective-required manifest are GENERATED by scripts/codegen-authoring.ts from the base+overlay JSON Schemas — never hand-typed.
$comment:
EFFECTIVE-REQUIRED MANIFEST (the answer to 'what does plugin-manifest require?' from one file — DR-044 D7(e)). This block is the generated effective-required surface; the source of truth is the `required` arrays of the two composed layers below.
  name         INHERITED   (upstream-base · code.claude.com plugins-reference standardFloor)
  version      REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  description  REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  author       REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  homepage     REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  license      REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  keywords     REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
  commands     REQUIRED HERE (is-overlay · promoted from upstream-optional)
Effective required = base ∪ overlay. securityChecks is inherited UNIVERSAL-IMMUTABLE. Resolving the $refs requires the base, overlay, and marketplace-tier schemas to be registered (e.g. ajv addSchema by $id); a dereferenced bundle is a codegen follow-on. Citations: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference § 'Plugin manifest schema'; tests/authoring/v1/fixtures/plugin-manifest/ (corpus-first ground truth).
